operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper explicitly states that reference and alternate AlphaGenome embeddings are interleaved. The catalog primitives do not establish alternating positional interleaving, so the transformation remains an opaque boundary.

The paper states that the Master Q-Former produces a fixed-length multimodal prefix for the LLM and that the ablation prepends modality-specific tokens to the LLM prompt. The catalog has concatenation and attention primitives, but no operation representing soft-prefix conditioning or virtual-token injection into a frozen LLM; the operation remains an opaque model boundary.
